entities.summary: Rodney McLeod Jr. is an American former professional football player who was a safety for 13 seasons in the National Football League (NFL). McLeod played college football for the Virginia Cavaliers and signed with the St. Louis Rams as an undrafted free agent in 2012. He has also played for the Philadelphia Eagles, with whom he won a Super Bowl in 2017, the Indianapolis Colts and the Cleveland Browns.
